detector: P2Rank 2.5 (default model), run on the ligand-stripped structure

geometry_method.grid_bounds: bounding box of the pocket-lining heavy atoms padded by 3 A; a cavity lobe reaching past that is not measured, so volume and extent are lower bounds for tunnel-shaped sites
geometry_method.cavity_point: grid point free of protein (dist to every heavy atom > vdW + 1.4 A probe), within 4.0 A of a pocket-lining heavy atom, and buriedness >= 0.75. The 0.75 bar is what separates the enclosed cavity from the thin solvent film that hugs the whole cleft surface; these are our definitions, so the volume is not comparable to an fpocket volume.
geometry_method.buriedness: fraction of 30 Fibonacci-sphere ray directions that strike a protein heavy atom within 12 A (sampled every 1.0 A)
geometry_method.component: cavity points are grouped into grid-connected components and only the component holding the P2Rank pocket centre is kept, so a surface groove elsewhere on the protein cannot inflate the volume or the docking box
geometry_method.concavity: fraction of cavity points lying inside the protein's convex hull (0-1)
geometry_method.depth_a: distance from a cavity point to the nearest convex-hull facet, mean and max
geometry_method.max_sphere_radius_a: max over cavity points of the distance to the nearest heavy-atom surface

docking_box.derived_from: cavity bounding box + 4 A padding, clipped to [16, 30] A

known_ligand_residue_ids: NOT SET HERE BY DESIGN - see known_ligand_contacts.json; site detection must not read it (PROJECT_GOAL.md B12)
